newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Fortis results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Fortis results.

text.p: Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis on Wednesday announced a 16 percent rise in net profit to 731 million ecus and said its parent companies expected to have higher earnings per share in 1997.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results.

"The results are fully in line with my forecast. They're a little bit cautious in their expectations just saying they expect higher EPS. But with MeesPierson on board I'm looking for another year of 15 percent EPS growth."
"It's just in line with our estimates. The Fortis group result is one million ECUs above and EPS is two cents better at Fortis AMEV."

"I had a rise of 17 percent (in Fortis Amev profits) and it turned out to be 16 percent. As far as the Fortis group result is concerned, I had an estimate of 738 million ECUs and it came out at 731 million."

"The only thing I can tell you is that the Fortis results were completely in line with our expectations. The Amev figures came in a little lower than we expected but I think that's because we calculated ours using a little higher ECU figure.

"They say they do expect a profit growth and that's clearer than what ABN AMRO said a few weeks ago. ABN AMRO declined to give a forecast for 1997. I think we're still very positive about the financial sector. We think the Dutch financial sector is very healthy and well positioned for strong growth."
